# Herdr App transport fixtures

All values are synthetic, including process numbers, names, paths and IDs.
No native application, daemon, agent, transcript or user configuration was
read to create them. Fixtures are test inputs, not native validation evidence.

App shapes follow the 0.1.14 source pin and core shapes follow the published
0.1.18 source pin in [ADR 0007](../../../../docs/adr/0007-herdr-app-0.1.14-source-review.md).
The small command/method listings intentionally include only the surfaces used
by these tests. Core version and feature changes, remote records and malformed
foreground metadata are derived in `index.cjs`. Oversize, fragmented Unicode,
disconnect, timeout and socket-replacement cases are generated by the contract
tests rather than retaining large or operating-system-specific recordings.

The App `status.zoom` value is UI scale. These fixtures neither expose the
missing fresh focus/Zoom snapshot nor grant any input capability. Frame streams,
subscriptions and production composition belong to later phases; the current
transport negotiates plain JSON lines and never attaches to a terminal.
